summary: Register one repository as an allowlisted Software workspace; the binary trust gate.

input_schema.path: string | Absolute path on the Brain Core host to the git repository root.
input_schema.default_executor: string | optional | null | default=claude_code | Default coding executor for tasks against this workspace (claude_code | codex | opencode).
input_schema.test_command: string | optional | null | Shell command run by the Service after each task to gate the commit step.
input_schema.max_wallclock_seconds: integer | optional | null | default=1800 | Hard wallclock budget per task against this workspace.
input_schema.branch_prefix: string | optional | null | default=brain/software/ | Branch prefix under which task branches are created.

output_schema.revoked_at: string | optional | ISO8601 revocation timestamp; null while active.

slash_command.name: workspace-register
slash_command.description: register a coding workspace (operator approval required)
